- Completed smell-6 boundary cleanup in tests/ha/support/docker/cli.rs by normalizing raw docker inspect JSON into DockerInspectEntry at the parse boundary.
- Validation and delivery complete: make lint passed, make test passed, committed as 9cd7f3d, and pushed to origin/master.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it updated Ralph task files and exited 0 but reproduced the already-tracked missing .ralph/current_task.txt cleanup error, leaving .ralph current task files modified in the worktree.

- Read previous Ralph progress: last run completed a boundary cleanup in tests/ha/support/docker/cli.rs, passed lint and test, committed/pushed, then task switch left expected .ralph task files dirty.
- Read improve-code-boundaries skill instructions: must check found_smells first, solve one boundary issue fully, prefer code reduction, and delete processed smell file if one exists.
- Checked worktree and top-level file list; only current dirty files are .ralph task state files plus a new progress jsonl.
- Next: inspect found_smells, inspect Makefile targets, then choose one concrete boundary cleanup in src/ or tests and implement it.

- Chose improve-code-boundaries smell-10 in src/ha/worker.rs.
- Verified build_leadership_view is only referenced from build_global_knowledge via compiler proof: temporary rename plus make check produced a single unresolved call at src/ha/worker.rs:397.
- Next: revert the temporary rename, inline leadership classification into build_global_knowledge, remove the fake helper boundary, then rerun lint and tests.

- Inlined leadership classification into build_global_knowledge in src/ha/worker.rs and removed build_leadership_view/classify_foreign_leader.
- Ran cargo fmt and make lint; clippy failed on one expected cleanup item: unused import LeaseEpoch in src/ha/worker.rs.
- Next: remove the dead import, rerun make lint, then run make test.

- make lint passed after removing the now-dead LeaseEpoch import.
- make test is currently running via cargo nextest for the full workspace/all-targets default profile.
- Next: wait for test completion, then inspect worktree, commit including .ralph files, push, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- make test passed: 243 tests passed, 16 skipped, 5 marked leaky by nextest, no failures.
- Boundary cleanup is ready for delivery; remaining work is repo bookkeeping only.
- Next: inspect final diff/status, commit including .ralph files, push origin/master, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Restored unrelated rustfmt-only changes in tests/ha/support/docker/cli.rs so the commit stays focused on this run's boundary cleanup.
- Staging src/ha/worker.rs plus required .ralph task/progress files now.
- Next: commit, push, then run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh and record its result.
